name: Century Aluminum (CENX)
teaser: Century Aluminum earned $2,480 per tonne of Midwest premium in Q2, 76% of the $3,250 metal price, and policy sets it. At $36.76 the stock is 12.2% above Base $32.77. Hold; the buy zone starts at $14.75.
llms: Primary aluminum smelter in the US and Iceland (Sebree, Mt. Holly, Grundartangi) with a consolidated Jamalco alumina refinery stake. Valued on mid-cycle EV to EBITDA after stock compensation under three aluminum price scenarios, cross-checked with a scenario cash flow model. Bear $4.49, Base $32.77, Bull $71.44. Verdict HOLD at $36.76; maximum buy price $14.75 at a required margin of safety of 55%.
